name: Semi-automatic pistol
definition: handgun with the chamber in the barrel that reloads itself from a magazine after each shot.

name: Double-action revolver
definition: handgun with a revolving cylinder whose trigger pull both cocks the hammer and fires.

name: Single-action revolver
definition: handgun with a revolving cylinder whose hammer is cocked by hand before each shot; a percussion revolver is this kind with `ignition` = percussion.

name: Bolt-action rifle
definition: rifled long gun loaded and cycled by a hand-operated rotating or straight-pull bolt.

name: Lever-action rifle
definition: rifled long gun cycled by a lever below the receiver.

name: Semi-automatic rifle
definition: rifled long gun that reloads itself from a magazine after each shot.

name: Single-shot rifle
definition: rifled long gun that holds one cartridge and is reloaded by hand after each shot.

name: Muzzle-loading rifle
definition: rifled long gun loaded with powder and projectile from the muzzle (E-21).

name: Over-under shotgun [Bockdoppelflinte]
definition: smoothbore long gun with two barrels stacked one above the other.

name: Side-by-side shotgun
definition: smoothbore long gun with two barrels placed beside each other.

name: Pump-action shotgun
definition: smoothbore long gun cycled by sliding the fore-end back and forth.

name: Semi-automatic shotgun [Selbstladeflinte]
definition: smoothbore long gun that reloads itself after each shot.

name: Muzzle-loading shotgun
definition: smoothbore long gun loaded with powder and shot from the muzzle (E-21).

name: Drilling or rifle-shotgun combination gun [Kombinierte Waffen]
definition: long gun with at least one rifled and one smoothbore barrel in one action.

name: Blank-firing pistol [Schreckschusswaffe]
definition: pistol that fires only blank, irritant or signal cartridges, made for self-defence or deterrence.

name: PCP air rifle
definition: air rifle fired from an on-board reservoir pre-charged with compressed air.

name: Piston air rifle
definition: air rifle that compresses its charge with a spring or gas piston at each cocking stroke; `piston_type` is an attribute.

name: CO2 air rifle
definition: air rifle powered by carbon dioxide from a capsule or cylinder.

name: CO2 air pistol
definition: air pistol powered by carbon dioxide from a capsule.

name: PCP air pistol
definition: air pistol fired from an on-board reservoir pre-charged with compressed air.

name: Recurve bow
definition: hand-drawn bow whose limb tips curve away from the archer.

name: Compound bow
definition: hand-drawn bow whose limbs are bent by a system of cams and cables that gives let-off at full draw.

name: Longbow
definition: tall hand-drawn bow with straight, narrow limbs.

name: Recurve crossbow
definition: crossbow with recurved limbs mounted across a stock and released by a trigger.

name: Compound crossbow
definition: crossbow whose limbs work through cams and cables.

name: Slingshot
definition: hand-held fork with elastic bands that launches a small projectile; E1 when made as a toy (K-84).

name: Blowgun
definition: tube through which a dart is propelled by the breath; E1 when made as a toy (K-84).

name: Arming sword
definition: one-handed straight double-edged sword with a cross guard.

name: Longsword
definition: straight double-edged sword with a hilt long enough for one or two hands.

name: Greatsword
definition: large straight double-edged sword wielded with two hands.

name: Sabre
definition: single-edged, usually curved cavalry sword; national and regional patterns are named forms.

name: Cutlass
definition: short, broad single-edged sword with a basket or cup guard.

name: Katana (Japanese long sword)
definition: curved single-edged Japanese long sword worn edge up through the sash.

name: Tachi (Japanese long sword)
definition: curved single-edged Japanese long sword slung edge down from the belt.

name: Wakizashi (Japanese short sword)
definition: single-edged Japanese short sword, the shorter blade of the daishō pair.

name: Tantō (Japanese dagger-length sword)
definition: single-edged Japanese blade under one shaku, a sword kind by tradition.

name: Rapier
definition: long, slender sword with a complex hilt made mainly for the thrust.

name: Smallsword
definition: light, short thrusting sword with a small guard.

name: Dagger
definition: short double-edged thrusting blade with a hilt.

name: Push dagger
definition: short blade set at right angles to a T-handle gripped in the fist.

name: Bowie or fighting knife
definition: large fixed-blade knife made for fighting, typically with a clip point and guard.

name: Hunting knife
definition: knife made for dressing and skinning game; skinning and caping knives are non-maker named forms (section 14 E4-5).

name: Karambit
definition: knife with a curved, claw-like blade and a finger ring, fixed or folding.

name: Butterfly knife
definition: folding knife whose two handles rotate around the tang to cover or expose the blade.

name: Automatic knife
definition: knife whose blade opens by a spring at the press of a button or switch, side-opening or out-the-front.

name: Throwing knife
definition: balanced knife made to be thrown at a target.

name: Bayonet
definition: blade made to fix to the muzzle of a firearm.

name: Shuriken
definition: hand-thrown star or spike with sharpened points; E1 when made as a toy (K-84).

name: Spear
definition: shaft with a pointed head made for thrusting or throwing; yari and qiang are named forms.

name: Halberd
definition: polearm combining an axe blade, a spike and a hook on one head.

name: Naginata
definition: Japanese polearm with a long curved single-edged blade.

name: Glaive
definition: polearm with a single-edged blade on the end of the shaft.

name: Battle axe
definition: axe made for fighting, not for cutting wood.

name: Tomahawk
definition: light one-handed axe made for fighting or throwing.

name: Bō staff
definition: long wooden staff used as a weapon.

name: Gun staff [棍]
definition: Chinese long staff weapon of the apparatus lists.

name: Mace
definition: club with a heavy head, often flanged or spiked.

name: War hammer
definition: hafted weapon with a hammer head, often backed by a spike.

name: Baton
definition: rigid or telescoping club made for striking.

name: Tonfa
definition: baton with a side handle set at right angles to the shaft.

name: Nunchaku
definition: two short sticks joined by a cord or chain.

name: Kubotan
definition: short rod held in the fist to strike or apply pressure.

name: Flail
definition: striking head joined to a handle by a chain.

name: Rope dart
definition: dart or blade on the end of a long rope, swung and cast.

name: Chain whip
definition: jointed steel segments ending in a dart, swung as a whip.

name: Three-section staff
definition: three staff sections joined end to end by chains or cords.

name: Pepper spray
definition: canister that sprays an irritant agent as a mist or stream.

name: Pepper gel
definition: canister that sprays an irritant agent as a sticky gel.

name: Pepper-ball launcher
definition: launcher that fires frangible projectiles filled with an irritant powder.

name: CO2 launcher
definition: compact CO2-powered launcher made for self-defence projectiles; may merge with E4.7.03 when attested.

name: Projectile electroshock weapon
definition: device that fires wired darts to deliver an incapacitating electric shock; TASER is a maker-bound named form.

name: Contact stun gun
definition: hand-held device that delivers an electric shock through electrodes pressed against the body.

name: Plate helmet
definition: metal helmet made against blows; burgonet is a named form.

name: Ballistic helmet
definition: helmet made against bullets and fragments; `protection_level` is an attribute (E-23, provisional).

name: Soft ballistic vest
definition: flexible body armour against handgun rounds.

name: Hard ballistic plate
definition: rigid armour plate against rifle rounds, worn alone or in a carrier.

name: Stab-resistant vest
definition: body armour made against knife and spike attacks (NIJ 0115.00).

name: Plate carrier
definition: vest made to hold hard armour plates, armour in its own right (K-84).

name: Gauntlet
definition: armoured glove protecting the hand and wrist.

name: Arm armour
definition: loose armour for the arm, such as vambrace and couter.

name: Leg armour
definition: loose armour for the leg, such as greave and cuisse.

name: Plate armour harness
definition: complete suit of plate armour; a garniture is a named form.

name: Shield
definition: hand-held protective barrier carried on the arm.

name: Centrefire handgun cartridge
definition: complete cartridge with a central primer made for handguns.

name: Centrefire rifle cartridge
definition: complete cartridge with a central primer made for rifles.

name: Rimfire cartridge
definition: complete cartridge whose priming compound sits in the rim.

name: Shotshell
definition: cartridge for a shotgun loaded with shot or a slug.

name: Muzzle-loading projectile
definition: ball or conical bullet loaded from the muzzle.

name: Black powder and substitute propellant
definition: black powder and its substitutes for muzzle-loading arms (E4-O2).

name: Air-gun pellet
definition: lead or alloy projectile made for air guns.

name: Arrow
definition: shafted projectile shot from a bow (E4-O1).

name: Crossbow bolt
definition: short shafted projectile shot from a crossbow.

name: Loose bullet
definition: projectile sold on its own for loading cartridges (K-86).

name: Primer
definition: ignition cap sold on its own for loading cartridges (K-86).

name: Smokeless propellant powder
definition: smokeless powder sold for loading cartridges (K-86).

name: Magazine
definition: detachable or fixed container that feeds cartridges into a firearm.

name: Bowstring
definition: string made to fit a bow or crossbow.

name: Arrow rest
definition: device on the bow riser that supports the arrow before release.

name: Scabbard
definition: sheath made to hold a sword or knife.

name: Sword guard
definition: loose guard for a sword hilt; tsuba is a non-maker named form.

name: Grip ornament (menuki)
definition: loose ornament fitted under the grip wrapping of a Japanese sword.

name: Rifle scope
definition: telescopic sight made to mount on a firearm, air rifle or crossbow.

name: Weapon light
definition: light made to mount on a weapon (K-162).

name: Bipod
definition: two-legged support made to mount on a weapon (K-163).

name: Shooting rest
definition: support on which a weapon is laid to steady the aim (K-163).
